item.galtc2.molten_ancient_second_rounde: Molten Ancient Second Rounder Metal Bucket
modifier.galtc2.aia.description: After taking 50 hits, increase armor and armor toughness by 1 point
modifier.galtc2.aid.flavor: High-performance robots resist damage for you
modifier.galtc2.aid.description: After taking damage, resist the same type of damage for 30s
modifier.galtc2.ancient_second_rounder.f: The old grudge between the second rounders and the sediment resurrecters.
modifier.galtc2.ancient_second_rounder.d: Melee attacks deal extra damage to resurrecters and sediment creatures (like Smite).
modifier.galtc2.aosora.description: Melee hits with an Aosora weapon launch the target about 64 blocks upward; arrow hits launch it about 32 blocks up; the target then falls back down naturally.
modifier.galtc2.azarashi.description: When attack value exceeds 100, triple the damage
modifier.galtc2.big_witchs_hat.descripti: Reduces magic damage taken by 30% and grants Magic Absorption.
modifier.galtc2.bitter_cold_hammer.flavo: Fall from the sky and freeze all beneath.
modifier.galtc2.bitter_cold_hammer.descr: Melee hits while falling (over 1.5 blocks, not elytra) deal extra damage based on fall height, multiplied by 1.5 on a falling crit.
modifier.galtc2.bright_land_beast_horn.f: Where the horn points, even giants fall.
modifier.galtc2.bright_land_beast_horn.d: Melee damage increases with the target's size (width x height, up to 10x base damage).
modifier.galtc2.bright_land_heart.flavor: The heartbeat of a grassland giant.
modifier.galtc2.bright_land_heart.descri: Grants +4 max health per piece while worn.
modifier.galtc2.camus.description: Applies healing prevention when attacking or being attacked in non-rainy daytime
modifier.galtc2.camus_armor: Defense of Camus Under the Clear Sky
modifier.galtc2.camus_armor.flavor: No one enjoys this weather more than I do.
modifier.galtc2.camus_armor.description: In clear weather, taking damage curses the attacker with heal-blocking.
modifier.galtc2.camus_melee.description: In clear weather, melee hits curse the target with heal-blocking.
modifier.galtc2.chain_bind.flavor: Chains wrap tight, leaving no escape.
modifier.galtc2.chain_bind.description: Melee hits have a 40% chance to anesthetize the target; each level raises its strength and duration.
modifier.galtc2.chainsaw.flavor: Hold to keep cutting, spraying blood.
modifier.galtc2.chainsaw.description: Hold right-click to continuously shred nearby enemies for 20% attack damage and apply bleeding; each hit costs 1 durability. Incompatible with other enhancements.
Raise the shield and spew serpon fire.
Hold right-click to charge, then release to cast the Serpon Flames spell. Incompatible with other enhancements.
modifier.galtc2.eightstrike.flavor: High attack speed, ignores invincibility frames
modifier.galtc2.eightstrike.description: Attack speed is multiplied by 8 and attack damage is reduced by 80%; hits ignore the target's invulnerability frames
modifier.galtc2.eightstrike_ranged.descr: Each shot fires 8 arrows, each dealing the arrow's full damage, while consuming only 1 ammo.
modifier.galtc2.euthanasia.description: Melee and arrow hits call down an unclean rain of blood on the target (spell from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.fire_apostle.description: Each armor piece reduces fire damage taken by 20% and increases fire damage dealt by 30%.
modifier.galtc2.fire_apostle_armor.descr: Each armor piece reduces fire damage taken (no longer increases fire damage dealt).
modifier.galtc2.firepower.flavor: One pull of the trigger, and arrows fall like rain.
modifier.galtc2.firepower.description: Draws 5x faster; fired projectiles ignore the target's invulnerability frames.
modifier.galtc2.giant_monster_hair_armor: Thick giant monster hair keeps out the cold.
Reduces freezing damage by 16% per armor piece worn (additive).
modifier.galtc2.giant_monster_hair_melee: A biting chill lurks within giant monster hair.
Melee hits deal an equal amount of additional freezing damage.
modifier.galtc2.guts.flavor: The heart in the cage is still beating.
modifier.galtc2.guts.description: Damage above 50% of your max health is halved (counted once even with several pieces).
modifier.galtc2.hag_eye.description: While worn or held, grants Night Vision and clears your Blindness and Darkness.
modifier.galtc2.healed_by_sister.descrip: Increases health regeneration, recovery amount scales with modifier level
modifier.galtc2.heartwall.description: Provides extra shield that absorbs damage first, regenerates 1 per second
modifier.galtc2.holy_warrior.flavor: The Ace of Iron takes the blow for you.
modifier.galtc2.holy_warrior.description: Each armor piece has a base 1/6 chance to completely negate incoming damage; the chance scales with your Luck (positive Luck caps out at 50%), and several pieces are rolled as independent chances.
modifier.galtc2.kagome.flavor: Kagome bears the negative effects for you
modifier.galtc2.kin_bond.flavor: Someone is waiting for you back home.
modifier.galtc2.kin_bond.description: Base 20% chance on a melee hit or when attacked to gain a random positive effect (Speed/Strength/Resistance/Regeneration) for 8 seconds; the chance scales with your Luck.
modifier.galtc2.kisaki.flavor: I won't allow my brother to be happy alone
modifier.galtc2.kisaki.description: While worn as armor: +4% damage reduction per game day worn (max 80%). Cost: Curse of Binding, fire damage taken x2 ignoring reduction, fire cannot be extinguished. Dying to fire resets reduction and forcibly unequips armor.
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_hates.flavor: If I were to fall in love with another man, I would rather die holding my longing for Ruri
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_hates.description: When used as a weapon: if the offhand holds a weapon not made of Kisaki material, it loses 1% durability per second.
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_likes.flavor: I want to be a little sister who is proud of loving her elder brother deeply
modifier.galtc2.kisaki_likes.description: When used as a weapon: attacking creatures that recently damaged you returns 30%/level of the damage they dealt. With an empty offhand or another Kisaki-made item, the main hand weapon repairs 0.5% durability per second and you regenerate 1 HP per second.
modifier.galtc2.kisaragikurenai.descript: Deals extra damage to non-spider creatures, increases health (armor)
modifier.galtc2.klaroro.flavor: It keeps a ledger of every crown it has taken.
modifier.galtc2.klaroro.description: Killing a Boss permanently grants +5% to all tool attributes (attack damage / attack speed / max health / armor / armor toughness / movement speed), up to +1000%. Bosses only - regular mobs do not count.
modifier.galtc2.skilled.description: Every 100 uses permanently grants +1% to all tool attributes (attack damage / attack speed / mining speed / durability / projectile damage / draw speed / velocity / armor / armor toughness / block amount). Breaking a block, hitting a mob, or firing a projectile each counts as one use. No cap.
modifier.galtc2.lavare.description: Deals extra damage to high health and high armor targets
modifier.galtc2.magicka_scale_upgrade.fl: Lay magicka scales over the scaly bear hide.
modifier.galtc2.magicka_scale_upgrade.de: Each level reduces fire/frost/lightning/drown damage by 23%; at level 4, reduces magic damage by 25% (an extra 15% below half health), grants immunity to cramming/suffocation/thorns, and grants Speed below half health.
modifier.galtc2.magicka_scale_upgrade.re: Requires Scaly Bear Scale in the tool parts
modifier.galtc2.meatbun.description: When equipped, hunger does not decrease
modifier.galtc2.meror_resistance.flavor: The damage reduction of Meror standard armor.
modifier.galtc2.meror_resistance.descrip: Reduces non-Meror damage by 12% per level (max level 4). Wearing multiple armor pieces with this trait adds their levels together, so four level-1 pieces equal level 4. Meror damage is not reduced.
modifier.galtc2.meror_standard.flavor: The standard combat gear of the Meror civilization.
modifier.galtc2.meror_standard.descripti: Works with any single piece: Night Vision/True Sight (and Water Breathing in water), Strength, Invisibility while sneaking, Speed and Jump while sprinting; reduces suffocation by 8 and damage by 4 (slowing magic attackers), grants fall immunity, and reduces damage taken by an extra 30%.
modifier.galtc2.meror_bolt.description: Arrow hits add Meror damage: +50%/100% of the arrow's base damage at level 1/2, settled once per arrow; J Village (Jerotes) treats this damage as Meror damage, so Meror Resistance does not reduce it.
modifier.galtc2.moon_cleave.description: Base 20% chance to deal double melee damage; the chance scales with your Luck (same formula as Meet Your Fight).
modifier.galtc2.morgana.description: Melee and arrow hits inflict a random debuff on the target, rolled from every harmful effect in Minecraft and all loaded mods (10 seconds; hitting the same one again stacks its strength). Wearing Morgana armor curses whoever attacks you as well.
modifier.galtc2.morgana_armor.flavor: What comes back lands on you.
modifier.galtc2.morgana_armor.descriptio: When you take damage, the attacker receives a random debuff.
modifier.galtc2.morgana_melee.descriptio: Melee or arrow hits inflict a random debuff on the target.
modifier.galtc2.mountain_realm.flavor: The weight of the mountain realm shakes the peaks.
modifier.galtc2.mountain_realm.descripti: Works with any single piece: daunts the target you look at, knocks melee targets flying, weakens nearby creatures while sprinting, and clears your own Slowness and Weakness.
modifier.galtc2.mossy_spike.flavor: The last tooth of the king of the swamp.
modifier.galtc2.mossy_spike.description: Melee hits deal +2 armor-piercing damage (ignores armor).
modifier.galtc2.muramasa.description: After killing an enemy creature, must kill a friendly creature; arrow hits cost 1 health.
modifier.galtc2.narcissus.flavor: Deals additional damage equal to 15% of target's maximum health
modifier.galtc2.narcissus.description: Deals extra damage equal to 15% of the target's max health per level; ranged extra damage is capped at 3x the arrow's damage.
modifier.galtc2.nighttimesheep.descripti: Attack values below 18 receive additional bonus
modifier.galtc2.noble_upgrade.flavor: The noble mark of the ancient second rounder smiths.
modifier.galtc2.noble_upgrade.descriptio: Won't be attacked by resurrecters while worn; melee hits summon a resurrecter.
modifier.galtc2.noble_upgrade.requiremen: Requires Ancient Second Rounder Metal in the tool parts
modifier.galtc2.oumunnbyou.flavor: Has a chance to stack cherry blossom marks
modifier.galtc2.oumunnbyou.description: At 5 cherry blossom marks, the disease erupts
modifier.galtc2.purple_sand_hag_eye.desc: Grants the Hag Eye's Night Vision and cleansing; strips Invisibility, Cloaking and True Invisibility from the target ahead within 32 blocks; grants True Sight while sneaking.
modifier.galtc2.qien.description: Adds damage based on current time, uses the larger of minute and hour
modifier.galtc2.qingfeng.description: Melee and arrow hits summon a plague of insects on the target; it lasts 10 seconds at level 1, +5 seconds per extra level, and bites harder with each level (spell from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.qoaiku_metal.flavor: A gift of the deep-sea folk.
modifier.galtc2.qoaiku_metal.description: Grants Water Breathing while worn or held.
modifier.galtc2.rewrite.description: On hit, copy the target's armour and max health onto yourself. Bonuses stack and each lasts 60s or until that target dies.
modifier.galtc2.rose_wraith.flavor: Beneath the roses, the wraiths dance.
modifier.galtc2.rose_wraith.description: 25% chance when attacked to summon a Rose Spirit beside your attacker: it follows you and keeps hunting your enemies until they fall, or fades after 15s (10s cooldown).
modifier.galtc2.rude.flavor: Deal extra damage to enemies with more than 20 health
modifier.galtc2.saya.description: After a melee hit, summons a tentacle near the target to help attack (tentacle from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.saya_armor.flavor: The tentacle takes the blow for you.
modifier.galtc2.saya_armor.description: After taking damage, summons a tentacle to strike back at the attacker (tentacle from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.saya_melee.flavor: The tentacle finds its own way to you.
modifier.galtc2.saya_melee.description: After a melee hit, summons a tentacle near the target to help attack (tentacle from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.scaly_bear_scale.flavor: Beneath the thick scales lies a beast instinct.
modifier.galtc2.scaly_bear_scale.descrip: Deals +20% damage to friendly creatures per level.
modifier.galtc2.scroll_cast.flavor: Imprint a flawless magic scroll into your tool.
modifier.galtc2.scroll_cast.description: Hold the tool, put a spell-bearing Flawless Magic Scroll in your offhand and sneak to copy the spell into the tool (consumes the scroll). Melee spells trigger on hit; other spells cast on right-click.
modifier.galtc2.seawave_trident.descript: Hold right-click to charge, then release to cast the Gemstone Waves spell. Incompatible with other enhancements.
modifier.galtc2.serpon_alloy.description: Each armor piece reduces fire damage taken by 10% and boosts fire damage dealt by 15%.
modifier.galtc2.serpon_alloy_armor.flavo: Scales hold off its own flames.
modifier.galtc2.serpon_alloy_armor.descr: Each armor piece reduces fire damage taken (no longer increases fire damage dealt).
modifier.galtc2.serpon_alloy_melee.descr: Increases the fire damage you deal (no longer reduces fire damage taken).
modifier.galtc2.serpon_powerhouse.requir: Requires Serpon Alloy in the tool parts
Requires Serpon Alloy; each armor piece reduces fire damage taken by 15%.
Requires Serpon Alloy; increases the fire damage you deal.
modifier.galtc2.shochou.description: Has a chance to drop money on hit, 2s cooldown
modifier.galtc2.shochou.description.dyna: Has a chance to drop money on hit, 2s cooldown
modifier.galtc2.shoujing.description: Calls the Darisorder to fight for you when you attack or are hit (from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.shoujing_armor.descripti: Calls the Darisorder to strike back when you take damage (from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.shoujing_melee.descripti: Calls the Darisorder to fight for you on a melee hit (from J Village; requires J Village).
modifier.galtc2.soul_eater.flavor: Phantoplasm swallows the last warmth of the dead.
modifier.galtc2.soul_eater.description: +2 block reach; both melee hits and arrow hits deal +50% extra damage per level to glowing mobs.
modifier.galtc2.sprb.description: 2 upgrade slots and 1 ability slot per level
modifier.galtc2.starry_travel.descriptio: The farther you are from world spawn, the higher your arrow crit chance (+10% per 5 chunks, capped at 100%) and crit damage (+50% base, +10% per 5 chunks, capped at +200%). Melee damage also scales with distance (+1 per 5 chunks).
modifier.galtc2.starry_travel_armor.desc: The further from spawn, the more armour and toughness (works for any entity).
modifier.galtc2.steinsgate.flavor: Deceive the world, fake death once
modifier.galtc2.steinsgate.description: Fake death once: keep 20% health and gain 3 seconds of invulnerability, 120 second cooldown (armour-side trait).
modifier.galtc2.super_lucky.description: +10 Fortune for pickaxe, +10 Looting for weapons
modifier.galtc2.super_lucky.requirements: Super High School Level Lucky requires Luck III as a prerequisite
modifier.galtc2.tagetes.description: Increases attack power based on lost health
modifier.galtc2.valuation.flavor: Based on luck value, small chance to damage yourself, high chance to deal 1~99x damage to enemies
modifier.galtc2.villager_metal.flavor: Among the crowd, even copper and iron take heart.
modifier.galtc2.villager_metal.descripti: Each nearby villager grants +5% attack and defense (within 16 blocks, up to 16 villagers, defense capped at 80% reduction).
modifier.galtc2.villager_metal_armor.des: Each nearby villager reduces damage taken by 5% (within 16 blocks, up to 16 villagers, capped at 80%).
modifier.galtc2.villager_metal_melee.fla: Among the crowd, even copper and iron take heart.
modifier.galtc2.villager_metal_melee.des: Each nearby villager grants +5% melee damage (within 16 blocks, up to 16 villagers); arrow hits deal extra flat damage equal to the number of nearby villagers (capped at 16) per level.
modifier.galtc2.vtb.flavor: Extra damage based on max health
modifier.galtc2.vtb.description: Adds 50% of max health as extra damage on attack
modifier.galtc2.wonderful.description: Double damage when falling from over 72 blocks
modifier.galtc2.yidian.description: Grants extra armor and armor toughness, larger value is armor, smaller is toughness
modifier.galtc2.zoulezoule.description: Each level increases movement speed by 10%
material.galtc2.ancient_second_rounder.e: A bronze-toned metal left by the ancient second rounder civilization, alloyed from iron and cobalt.
material.galtc2.euthanasia.encyclopedia: Melee and ranged attacks alike bring down an unclean rain of blood.
material.galtc2.fire_apostle.encyclopedi: Blazing metal left by the Fire Apostle civilization.
material.galtc2.fortunes_favor.encyclope: The wager Dame Fortuna left behind. Luck is a skill too.
material.galtc2.galaxy_railroad.encyclop: The farther from spawn, the higher the damage and armor (+1 per 5 chunks); in clear weather hits and being hit apply heal-blocking; falls over 72 blocks deal double damage
material.galtc2.giant_monster_hair.encyc: Hair from a giant monster, tough and durable.
material.galtc2.meror.encyclopedia: Metal smelted by the Meror civilization.
material.galtc2.morgana.encyclopedia: Curses come as they please, and are repaid to anyone who dares harm you.
material.galtc2.mossy_tooth.encyclopedia: A tooth of Swampjaw, still reeking of the swamp king.
material.galtc2.mountain_realm.encyclope: The crystallization of the Mountain Realm Tyrant's metallurgy.
material.galtc2.muramasa.encyclopedia: This is Not a Hero's Tale
material.galtc2.narcissus.encyclopedia: If your life had a countdown, what would you think about?
material.galtc2.nishiki_asumi.encycloped: Never hungry, extra damage based on max health
material.galtc2.phantoplasm.encyclopedia: Ghostly residue stripped from the Bellringer.
material.galtc2.qingfeng.encyclopedia: Under the clear maple the swarm answers the call, and lingers longer at higher tiers.
material.galtc2.qoaiku_metal.encyclopedi: Metal forged by the Qoaiku alliance.
material.galtc2.rewrite.encyclopedia: Copy the target's armour and max health on hit
material.galtc2.saya.encyclopedia: A dark-green indescribable thing, said to come from Saya.
material.galtc2.serpon_alloy.encyclopedi: Alloy forged by the Serpon combat team.
material.galtc2.shoujing.encyclopedia: The power of Shoujing, balanced between offense and defense.
material.galtc2.tsukiyashiro_kisaki.ency: Armor that grows stronger the longer it is worn, but fire is its price
material.galtc2.villager_metal.encyclope: An alloy smelted from copper and iron, commonly used by the Jerotes villagers.
material.galtc2.violet_bloom.encyclopedi: A flower that fell from Rosalyne's hands.
message.galtc.death_immunity: Deceive the world, El Psy Congroo
death.attack.meror_shot: %1$s was pierced by a Meror bolt
modifier.galtc2.soul_heart.flavor: The resentment of the dead gathers here.
modifier.galtc2.soul_heart.description: Deal 25% more damage to undead and the Night Lich, and take 25% less damage from them.
modifier.galtc2.ancient_anima.descriptio: Right click to launch a random Comet or Frost Star.
modifier.galtc2.void_thorn.description: Spawn thorns under the target on hit.
modifier.galtc2.obsidian_heart.descripti: Spawn spikes under the target at random on hit.
modifier.galtc2.blazing_eye.description: Hold right click to fire a laser that burns whatever it hits.
modifier.galtc2.armor_fracture.flavor: One crack in the bronze law, and plate gives way.
modifier.galtc2.armor_fracture.descripti: Hits inflict Armor Fracture, cutting the target's armor and armor toughness by 30%. Lasts 5 seconds at level 1, +2 seconds per extra level.
modifier.galtc2.resonant_wave.flavor: Strike it standing, and the echo crosses the whole court.
modifier.galtc2.resonant_wave.descriptio: Right click while standing on the ground: release an expanding resonant wave dealing 8 damage and 8 seconds of Armor Fracture. 8 second cooldown, shared with the Resonant Bell.
modifier.galtc2.echo_slam.flavor: Every second you hold it goes into the tone.
modifier.galtc2.echo_slam.description: Hold right click to charge, then release to slam the ground ahead: panel damage × seconds charged × level to everything within 5 blocks / 120 degrees, plus 5 seconds of Armor Fracture and knockback. The charge caps at 9 seconds and slams on its own when full; 5 second cooldown, shared with the Echo Maul.
modifier.galtc2.echo_slam.cap: Charge cap: %s seconds (slams automatically when full)
modifier.galtc2.bell_ward.flavor: One bell note, and your feet take root.
modifier.galtc2.bell_ward.description: Each level grants 5% knockback resistance; single hits of 6 damage or more are reduced by 30%.
modifier.galtc2.court_puppet.flavor: Save your Binding Seal — one bell note and the puppet answers.
modifier.galtc2.court_puppet.description: Right click to summon a Court Puppet bound to you (32 health, follows and protects). 3 minute cooldown, summoning again recalls the previous one.
modifier.galtc2.love_grows.flavor: Jiu Hu remembers the days you spent together.
modifier.galtc2.love_grows.description: Adds base stats (durability / attack damage / mining speed) based on the fox maid's favorability: +1 at 0-63, +2 at 64-127, +3 at 128-191, +4 at 192+. Scales with modifier level. With multiple fox maids the highest favorability is used, including maids stored in a soul amulet.
modifier.galtc2.true_love.description: On arrow hit, the target prefers any creature other than players and Jiu Hu as its target for 5 seconds. Does not work on bosses.
modifier.galtc2.one_heart.description: Worn by a player: 80% of the damage Jiu Hu takes is transferred to the player. Worn by Jiu Hu: grants Resistance II and Regeneration III.
modifier.galtc2.naga_quake.flavor: The ground still remembers the thud of its passing.
modifier.galtc2.naga_quake.description: On melee hit: 25% chance (+10% per level) to call down the Naga's boulder onto the target. A rune warning ring appears first; on impact it triggers the shockwave ring, ground debris and explosion, dealing the original mod's Boulder Impact damage (default 10/6 × attack damage, configurable). 3 second cooldown, tracked per tool.
modifier.galtc2.naga_quake.tip: Naga Quake: %s%% chance to call a boulder (damage uses the mod's configured multiplier)
modifier.galtc2.golem_cage.flavor: When the cage closes, even the sound crystallizes.
modifier.galtc2.golem_cage.description: When hit (5 second cooldown, only the first of four armor pieces resolves): raise a crystal cage under the attacker, dealing the original mod's cage damage with shard effects, plus 3 seconds of Slowness II and Mining Fatigue.
modifier.galtc2.golem_cage.tip: Crystal Cage: summons a cage when hit, 5 second cooldown
modifier.galtc2.spirit_swordfall.flavor: When the sky light falls, the swords arrive first.
modifier.galtc2.spirit_swordfall.descrip: Right click: scan for enemies within 12 blocks around you and call one greatsword down on each (up to 8, nearest first). Each shows a shrinking warning ring, the sword falls from 14 blocks up, and on impact bursts into soul-flame shockwave rings, dealing the original mod's Sword Fall damage (default 12/11 × attack damage) and launching enemies. With no enemies nearby it can be swung freely without spending the cooldown. 10 second cooldown, tracked per tool.
modifier.galtc2.spirit_swordfall.tip: Spirit Swordfall: one greatsword per enemy within 12 blocks, 10 second cooldown
modifier.galtc2.shaday_ranged.descriptio: On projectile hit, five dragon spikes (oversized pointed dripstone) fall in sequence across a 5×5 area around the impact point: each shows a shrinking warning ring, then erupts for area damage and a launch.
modifier.galtc2.shaday_ranged.flavor: One day at a time, and then dragon spikes fall from the sky.
material.galtc2.shaday.flavor: Shadow stripped from an Aether Dragon, reforged into the shape of its soul.
material.galtc2.shaday.encyclopedia: Cast from the same deep-navy metal as the Aether Shaday armour, its edges trimmed with amber light; teal dragon breath sometimes rises from the melt. Tools bathed in it trail dragon flame and claw afterimages.
modifier.galtc2.shaday.flavor: When the dragon flame passes, the light goes out half a second first.
modifier.galtc2.shaday.description: Hits carry the Aether Dragon's claw particle effect; deals 50% extra damage to non-Aether creatures (Aether, Bedrock Mobs and Dragon creatures are exempt).
modifier.galtc2.shaday_armor.flavor: The seat on a dragon's back was never only the rider's.
modifier.galtc2.shaday_armor.description: While riding an Aether Dragon, incoming damage is first reduced by 50% and the remainder is borne by the mount; only the first of the four armour pieces resolves it.
material.galtc2.jiuhu.flavor: A fox girl who loves wine.
material.galtc2.jiuhu.encyclopedia: Jiu Hu quietly saves these ingots while she works. She is probably planning to make something for you. The fonder she is of you, the faster she saves them — every point of favorability immediately adds five more to her backpack. But she is only one girl: a full day of work wears her out, and she needs a full day of rest to recover.
jei.galtc2.jiuhu_ingot.1: Jiu Hu quietly saves these ingots while she works, keeping them in her own backpack.
jei.galtc2.jiuhu_ingot.2: Higher favorability means she saves them faster, and every point of favorability gained gives five extra ingots.
jei.galtc2.jiuhu_ingot.3: A full day of work tires her out; she needs a day of rest before she starts again.
message.galtc2.jiuhu_tired: Jiu Hu has worked a full day and is exhausted. Let her rest for a whole day before she saves ingots again.
message.galtc2.jiuhu_rested: Jiu Hu is rested and ready to work again.
material.galtc2.tianjin_zui.flavor:
There is a thing called Amatsutsumi — not a sin of man, but a sin of the gods.
To take from someone the will and the wish to live, for which they would give everything — even wrought by an almighty god, that is a sin.
modifier.galtc2.tianjin_zui.flavor: Edict: to take wing is a sin — flight is forbidden.
modifier.galtc2.tianjin_zui.description: While held or worn, spreads a field that grounds creatures within 10 blocks. The radius grows with the modifier level.
modifier.galtc2.tianjin_zui_no_spawn.fla: Edict: to breed is a sin — no new life shall be born.
modifier.galtc2.tianjin_zui_no_spawn.des: While held or worn, nothing can spawn within the field.
modifier.galtc2.zeroone_armor.flavor: A step ahead even when hit
modifier.galtc2.zeroone_armor.descriptio: Extends the invulnerability window after being hit (20 ticks to 30), blocking multi-hit damage.
modifier.galtc2.narcissus_armor.descript: Immunity to damage below your max health
modifier.galtc2.ca_armor.description: Grants armor equal to luck × luck
modifier.galtc2.azarashi_armor.descripti: Triples your armor when it exceeds 50
modifier.galtc2.blacklily_armor.descript: Armor grows as health is lost; up to 30% less damage from attackers with high health or armor
modifier.galtc2.shochou_armor.descriptio: Grants armor based on the money in your inventory (+0.25 each, up to +20)
modifier.galtc2.ciallo_armor.description: Plays the Ciallo sound when hit
modifier.galtc2.ancient_second_rounder_a: Experience of the Ancient Second Rounder
Reduces damage from resurrecters and sunken creatures by 25%
modifier.galtc2.scaly_bear_scale_armor.d: Reduces damage from neutral mobs by 20%
modifier.galtc2.golem_spike_charge.descr: When you land from a sprint-jump, or from a high-speed jump while under a speed effect, leaves a trail of seven Crystalite Golem spikes behind you along your movement direction (the mod's own spike skill: erupt damage + crystal shard effects). 10 second cooldown; only the first of the four armour pieces resolves it.
modifier.galtc2.golem_spike_charge.flavo: Run fast enough and the shards will chase them for you.
modifier.galtc2.golem_spike_charge.tip: Landing from a sprint-jump or a high-speed jump leaves crystal spikes behind, 10 second cooldown
task.galtc2.tinkers_bow_attack.desc: Auto-targets and shoots with Tinkers bows and longbows; projectiles and modifiers use Tinkers logic.
modifier.galtc2.love_grows.tip: Base stats from fox maid favorability (+1 to +4)
modifier.galtc2.rewrite_armor.descriptio: When hit, copy the attacker's armour, toughness and max health onto yourself for 5s. The attacker is unaffected; max health can be copied at most once every 5s.
modifier.galtc2.oumnnbyou_armor.descript: When hit, stack the sakura mark on the attacker (up to 5 stacks).
